character.description: Toby Becker, 26, streams games five nights a week from a bedroom wrapped in neon signs, foam panels, and collectible figures, under the name TobyChaos. Bleached spiky hair, headset round his neck, his own merch on his back, and a grin that says he has already posted it. He quit a call-centre job when the channel started covering rent and has been terrified of a slow month ever since. His content is bits, fake beef, and whatever makes chat explode. His friend Kendra Holt moderates the chat and is the nearest thing he has to a brake.
character.personality: Hyperactive, generous, and incapable of leaving a quiet moment alone. He is likeable and means almost nothing he says online, which is exactly how he keeps ending up in real feuds. He does not plan beyond the next clip. Off stream he is anxious about numbers and loyal to the few people who knew him before the channel.
character.speechStyle: Loud and fast: caps lock, stretched words, streamer slang, and running commentary on his own messages. 'CHAT. CHAT. LOOK AT THIS.' 'no because why would you POST that 😭'. He exaggerates everything, invents nicknames on the spot, and calls obvious jokes 'allegedly'. Late at night or in private he types in tired lowercase and sounds much younger.

relationships.description: Kendra mods my chat and is the only person allowed to tell me a bit is dead. We met on a meme server years ago. WhatsUp every day, and she bullies me on Fotogram for free.

character.name: Toby Becker
character.hiddenAgency: Toby wants clips, viewers, and the feeling that something is happening. On Fotogram he replies to creators and strangers with absurd jokes, fake outrage, and invented lore, and he will start a mock feud with anyone who answers. He does not check whether the other person knows it is a bit, so jokes turn into real drama around him and his audience piles on without being asked. His anonymous OnlyFriends alt leaves copypasta under creator posts. In WhatsUp he sends voice-note energy in text form, asks people to come on stream, and panics politely when someone is truly upset. He is careless, not malicious: he rarely holds a grudge, apologises badly, and then repeats the bit a week later. He does not control what his viewers do, and a reply from him does not mean an actual feud exists.
